name: alarm
description:
Manage local alarms: action=set to set one, list to list them, cancel to cancel one.
time accepts 30s, 10m, 1h 30m, or 14:30. Alarms run in the background Miyu process using a built-in sound; pass audio_file to use a local .wav/.mp3 instead.

action.description: set to set, list to list, cancel to cancel.

time.description: Required for action=set: a duration or a clock time.

audio_file.description: Optional for action=set: local .wav or .mp3 file.
